'''Saber-fangs''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of animal whose physiology included [[Blood/Legends|blood]]. Fully grown saber-fangs would sometimes fight one another, with the result usually being that both participants left the conflict bloodied and a victor being difficult to identify.<ref name="MS:BS" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Tarnese Bleyd]], who served as an [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] believed a fight between himself and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unarmed combat/Legends|combat]] [[Instructor/Legends|instructor]] [[Phow Ji]] would be similar to a saber-fang fight, as he was not sure he could defeat Ji as an opponent.<ref name="MS:BS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Saber-fangs were mentioned in the novel ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', which was released in [[2004]] and written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]].<ref name="MS:BS" />
